from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class LegalDocument(BaseModel):
    """A single legal document with its identifying title and legal classification."""
    title: str = Field(description="The official title or identifier of the document (e.g., '判决文书 1')")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The specific cause of action (案由) as stated in the document")
    case_category: str | None = Field(description="The broader legal category (e.g., '侵权责任纠纷', '行政给付', '国家赔偿')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates all processed legal documents for the task."""
    documents: list[LegalDocument]
